summary: NeoGenomics, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a civil settlement with the DOJ on behalf of OIG-HHS regarding an internal investigation into compliance of consulting agreements with federal healthcare laws. The settlement requires a payment of $9,813,260, which is below the previously accrued reserve of $11.2 million. The filing is a regulatory disclosure of a legal resolution, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The settlement does not involve a change in control, restructuring, or capital return.
